"""Renewal reminders (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

REMINDER_DAYS_BEFORE = 3


def reminder_due(renewal_at: datetime, now: datetime | None = None) -> bool:
    now = now or datetime.now()
    return renewal_at - timedelta(days=REMINDER_DAYS_BEFORE) <= now < renewal_at


def next_renewal(sub, after):
    """First renewal strictly after ``after``."""
    period = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)
    if after < sub.started_at:
        return sub.started_at + period
    elapsed = after - sub.started_at
    periods = elapsed // period + 1
    return sub.started_at + periods * period
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from .errors import BillingError

from ledgerly.models import Subscription
from ledgerly.renewals import next_renewal


def test_next_renewal():
    sub = Subscription("sub_1", "cus_1", Decimal("30.00"), 30, datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert next_renewal(sub, datetime(2026, 1, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)) == datetime(2026, 1, 31, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Subscription


def current_period(sub: Subscription, at: datetime) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    """Return the [start, end) billing period of ``sub`` that contains ``at``."""
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    start = ensure_utc(sub.started_at)
    if at < start:
        raise BillingError("before_start", at.isoformat())
    length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)
    n = (at - start) // length
    period_start = start + n * length
    return period_start, period_start + length
